In 2020, Michael B. Jordan won Outstanding Actor in a Motion Picture at the NAACP Image Awards for Just Mercy.

Yesterday, Sinners makes history with 16 Academy Award nominations, and Michael earns his first Oscar nomination for Best Actor.

The NAACP Image Awards  has always and will always, proudly uplift the voices and achievements that continue to move the industry forward. #NAACPImageAwards | BET | Facebook
